Fresh and effortlessly stylish, these boys’ sky blue denim jeans feature a contemporary wide straight-leg silhouette with soft washed fading and classic denim detailing. A versatile everyday essential that pairs easily with T-shirts, polos, casual shirts, sweatshirts and jackets.

Bring a fresh denim look to his everyday wardrobe with these Boys’ sky Blue Wash Wide-Leg Denim Jeans. Designed with a clean, modern appearance, this pair combines a relaxed wider-leg profile with timeless jeans detailing for comfortable and versatile casual styling. The sky blue denim is enhanced with a soft washed effect and gradual fading through the thighs and legs, creating attractive depth without heavy distressing or excessive decoration. Subtle horizontal wash lines around the upper section add further character while preserving the jeans’ neat overall appearance. Classic construction details include a button-fastened waistband, belt loops, front fly construction, curved front pockets and a coin pocket. Metallic rivet accents and contrasting denim stitching provide an authentic jeans-inspired finish. The wide straight-leg cut gives the jeans a modern, relaxed silhouette with generous width continuing toward the hem. The completely unprinted design makes this style particularly easy to coordinate with both colorful and neutral tops. Ideal for everyday wear, family outings, shopping, travelling, casual gatherings and weekend activities. Product Highlights: Sky blue washed denim; contemporary wide straight-leg silhouette; soft thigh fading; subtle upper-leg wash effect; clean unprinted design; button fastening; belt loops; front fly construction; curved front pockets; coin pocket; metallic rivet accents; contrast stitching; full-length design; versatile casual styling.

Fabric
Fabric Type: Denim / Jeans Fabric Garment Type: Boys’ Jeans Pant Fit: Wide Straight-Leg Finish: Sky Blue Washed & Faded Denim
Care Instructions
Turn the jeans inside out before washing to help maintain their original washed appearance and denim surface. Wash with similar colors and avoid harsh detergents or bleach. As with washed denim, slight color variation and gradual fading may naturally develop over time.
